title: 第一卷 第28章 沉睡地龙二第一卷 第27章 沉睡地龙
slug: 百倍返还我家孽徒全是女帝转世
content_zh:
：话音刚落，湖面平静的水面忽然剧烈翻滚起来！
轰隆隆！
一道巨大的水柱冲天而起，水柱顶端凝聚出一头通体透明、鳞甲分明的蛟龙虚影，那金之本源的光芒被它一口叼住，悬在口中。
蛟龙虚影居高临下俯视三人，眼神冰冷而漠然，宛如一尊镇守宝物的神祇。
“八阶妖兽！”林枫倒吸一口凉气，“半步元婴！”
这东西，比他之前遇到的所有妖兽加起来都难缠。
蛟龙虚影只是张口发出一声低沉的吟啸，三人脚下的地面就咔嚓咔嚓裂开细密的纹路。
“雨姝，赤瑶，退到山谷口去！”林枫头也不回地喝道。
“师父！”柳雨姝不肯。
“听话！你们在这里，我反而要分心！”
柳雨姝攥紧拳头，咬牙扯着赤瑶往后退，退到山谷入口处，远远望着湖心的动静。
林枫面对那头蛟龙虚影，深深吐了一口气。
他掏出一株白鎏参，几口塞进嘴里疯狂咀嚼，同时掏出一枚地品聚灵丹扔进嘴里。
体内灵力瞬间暴涨一大截，经脉都被撑得胀痛。
蛟龙虚影见他居然还敢当面嗑药，眼神里明显闪过一丝轻蔑。
它长尾一扫，平静的湖面瞬间掀起数丈高的水浪，裹挟着千钧之力朝林枫砸来！
林枫一边催动空幻无影步闪避，一边朝湖心石台猛冲。
他根本不打算跟这半步元婴的蛟龙硬刚，他的目标就是那团金之本源！
蛟龙看穿了他的意图，一声怒吟，整片湖水倒卷而起，在半空凝成数十道水刃，从四面八方封死了他所有退路。
“琉璃罩！”

一层淡金色的光罩将林枫裹住，水刃噼里啪啦砸在上面，震得光罩疯狂颤动。
林枫咬紧牙关，借着水刃冲撞的冲击力，整个人像炮弹一样弹射出去，直扑湖心石台。
蛟龙虚影猛然炸开，化作漫天水珠，又在他前方重新凝聚，巨口已经张开，里面蓄着一团湛蓝色的灵力光球，威压恐怖。
那光球一旦吐出，足以把整个湖心石台炸成粉末！
“糟了……”
林枫心一横，干脆不管不顾，全身灵力尽数催动，清霜剑脱手飞出，直刺石台中央那团金之本源。
剑尖刺入光团的一刹那，金之本源猛然炸开，化作漫天金色光雨，疯狂涌向林枫体内。
与此同时，蛟龙的灵力光球也轰然炸裂，恐怖的冲击波将林枫整个人掀飞出去！
“师父！”
柳雨姝和赤瑶同时尖叫。
漫天金色光雨与湛蓝冲击波在空中激烈碰撞，湖面炸开，水花四溅。
content_en:
: As soon as he finished speaking, the calm water surface of the lake suddenly rolled violently!
Boom!
A huge water column rose into the sky, and the top of the water column condensed into the shadow of a transparent dragon with clear scales. The light of the origin of gold was caught in its mouth and hung in its mouth.
The phantom of the dragon looked down at the three of them, his eyes cold and indifferent, like a god guarding treasures.
"Eighth-level monster!" Lin Feng took a breath, "Half-step Nascent Soul!"
This thing was more difficult to deal with than all the monsters he had encountered before put together.
The dragon phantom just opened its mouth and let out a low roar, and the ground under the three people's feet cracked and cracked into fine lines.
"Yushu, Chiyao, retreat to the mouth of the valley!" Lin Feng shouted without looking back.
"Master!" Liu Yushu refused.
"Obey! If you are here, I will be distracted!"
Liu Yushu clenched her fists, gritted her teeth, and pulled Chiyao back to the entrance of the valley, watching the movement in the center of the lake from a distance.
Lin Feng faced the phantom of the dragon and took a deep breath.
He took out a piece of white ginseng, stuffed a few mouthfuls into his mouth and chewed it wildly. At the same time, he took out a ground-grade spirit-gathering pill and threw it into his mouth.
The spiritual energy in his body instantly surged so much that his meridians were stretched to the point of swelling and pain.
When Jiaolong Xuying saw that he actually dared to take drugs in front of him, there was a clear trace of contempt in his eyes.
With a sweep of its long tail, the calm lake surface instantly stirred up water waves several feet high, slamming towards Lin Feng with a huge force!
Lin Feng used the Konghuan Shadowless Step to dodge, and rushed towards the stone platform in the center of the lake.
He has no intention of confronting this half-step Nascent Soul dragon. His target is the origin of the gold!
The dragon saw through his intentions, and with an angry roar, the entire lake rolled up and condensed into dozens of water blades in mid-air, blocking all his escape routes from all directions.
"Liu Li cover!"
A layer of light golden light shield enveloped Lin Feng, and the water blade crackled on it, causing the light shield to tremble crazily.
Lin Feng gritted his teeth, and with the impact of the collision of the water blade, his whole body was ejected like a cannonball, heading straight towards the stone platform in the center of the lake.
The dragon's phantom exploded suddenly, turning into water droplets all over the sky, and then condensed again in front of him. The huge mouth had been opened, and there was a ball of blue spiritual power inside, which was terrifying.
Once the light ball is spit out, it will be enough to explode the entire stone platform in the center of the lake into powder!
"Oops..."
Lin Feng's heart skipped a beat, and he simply ignored it. He activated all his spiritual power, and the Qingshuang Sword flew out of his hand, piercing the golden source in the center of the stone platform.
The moment the sword tip pierced the ball of light, the source of gold suddenly exploded, turning into a rain of golden light that filled the sky, and rushed into Lin Feng's body crazily.
At the same time, Jiaolong's spiritual light ball also exploded, and the terrifying shock wave flew Lin Feng's entire body away!
"Master!"
Liu Yushu and Chiyao screamed at the same time.
The golden light rain in the sky and the blue shock wave collided fiercely in the air, and the lake surface exploded, with water splashing everywhere.
